description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy for different models. The x-axis represents the number of frames, with a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 60, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis represents accuracy as a percentage, also with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 54, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains four lines: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" in blue with circle markers and a solid line style, "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" in green with circle markers and a solid line style, "PLLaVA (DP 8)" in orange with square markers and a solid line style, and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" in red with square markers and a solid line style. The blue line starts at around 52.8% accuracy at 10 frames and increases to approximately 54.1% at 64 frames. The green line begins at around 52.7% accuracy at 10 frames and rises to about 54% at 16 frames, remaining steady thereafter. The orange line starts at around 45% accuracy at 10 frames and decreases to approximately 39.5% at 64 frames. The red line begins at around 46.5% accuracy at 10 frames and declines to about 42% at 64 frames.
